lines.japanese: 「あー、すみません、せっかく遊びに来てもらったのに、食器の片付けまでしてもらっちゃって」
lines.english: “Ah, I'm sorry. You came all this way to visit, and I even made you help clear the dishes.”

lines.japanese: 「ね、一人暮らしは大変でしょ？　ふふっ」
lines.english: “See? Living alone is hard, isn't it? Hee-hee.”

lines.japanese: 「彼女でも作れば？」
lines.english: “Why don't you get a girlfriend?”

lines.japanese: 「あんた分かってて言ってんでしょう。受験生にそんな余裕ありませんよ」
lines.english: “You know exactly what you're doing. I've got entrance exams to study for; I don't have time for that.”

lines.japanese: 「へー、余裕があれば出来るみたいな言い方に聞こえるけど？」
lines.english: Huh. You make it sound like you could get one if you had the time.

lines.japanese: 「こらこらえりちゃん、弱い者いじめしないの。じゃあ私たちそろそろ帰るね」
lines.english: “Now, now, Eri. No picking on the weak. We should be going.”

lines.japanese: 「き、紀奈子さんまでっ！　弱い者なんかじゃないっ！」
lines.english: “K-Kinako, you too?! I'm not weak!”

lines.japanese: 「ないっ……」
lines.english: “I'm not...”

lines.japanese: しかし優しいお姉さま方は、そこで無情にもドアを閉じた。
lines.english: But the kindly ladies closed the door on me without a shred of mercy.

lines.japanese: はあ、まだまだ自立への道は遠いなあ……。
lines.english: Sigh. The road to independence was still a long one...

lines.japanese: 俺は窓を開けて、去っていく二人の先輩を見送った。
lines.english: I opened the window and watched my two older friends from school walk away.

lines.japanese: 天を見上げると真っ青な春の空。
lines.english: When I looked up, a brilliant blue spring sky spread overhead.

lines.japanese: こういう誰にでも健康さを求める青ってのはどうなんだろう。少し吹きだしながら、去年見た蕭条たる１２月の空を思いだした。
lines.english: What was I supposed to make of that blue, demanding robust good health from everyone beneath it? With a quiet laugh, I remembered the desolate December sky of the year before.

lines.japanese: ああ……。
lines.english: Ah...

lines.japanese: 大事な時期に遊びすぎたなあ。
lines.english: I'd fooled around far too much at a crucial time.

lines.japanese: それだけを理由にするのは図々しいけど、かと言って原因の一つであることには間違いないので、俺は空に向かって間抜けた面をしたまま、時間戻らねえかなあと呟いた。
lines.english: It would have been shameless to blame everything on that. Then again, there was no denying it had contributed. Still making a stupid face at the sky, I muttered, “Any chance time could go backward?”

lines.japanese: 結論から言うと、俺は大学受験に失敗した。
lines.english: To cut to the chase, I failed my university entrance exams.

lines.japanese: 受験校を絞りすぎたのもあると思うけど、試験は水物。見事に玉砕した。
lines.english: Perhaps I had narrowed my target schools too aggressively, but exams are fickle things. I went down in magnificent defeat.

lines.japanese: で、叔父さん叔母さんとも相談した結果、どうしても進学したいということで、俺はいま浪人中だ。
lines.english: After talking it through with my aunt and uncle, I decided I wanted to attend university badly enough to try again. So I was spending a year studying to retake the entrance exams.

lines.japanese: 鷲介と隼人の貯金を元にして、紀奈子さんや英里子さんからのアドバイスの元、一人暮らしを始めて予備校にも通ってる。
lines.english: With the savings Shusuke and Hayato had accumulated, and with advice from Kinako and Eriko, I had begun living alone and attending prep school.

lines.japanese: ああそう、一人暮らし始めたんだよ。
lines.english: Oh, right. I had started living on my own.

lines.japanese: 叔父さんと叔母さんは家に居ても構わないって言ってくれたけど、もう社会的にも健康な一人前の男だし、受験に専念するためにも柳木原の安アパートに引っ越した。
lines.english: My aunt and uncle said I was welcome to stay at home. But I was a healthy grown man now, able to make my own way in the world, and a cheap apartment in Yanagihara would let me focus on my exams.

lines.japanese: まあ、引っ越した理由にはもう一つあって、小鳩との約束……。
lines.english: Well, there was one other reason I moved out: the promise I had made with Kobato...

lines.japanese: 広い世界を見て、小鳩との関係を見つめなおすこと。
lines.english: To see more of the world, and reconsider what Kobato and I were to each other.

lines.japanese: ただ近くにいたひとに頼っていただけなのか、一人の女性として好きなのか。その答えを冷静に考えるためにしばらく彼女と離れた生活を送ることにした。
lines.english: Had I merely depended upon the person who happened to be closest, or did I love her as a woman? To consider the answer with a clear head, I chose to live apart from her for a while.

lines.japanese: ただ実際にはやることが多すぎて、そっちに忙殺されてるのが現状だ。
lines.english: In practice, I had so much to do that I was swamped.

lines.japanese: ああ、ダメな兄だなあ……。
lines.english: Ah, what a hopeless brother...

lines.japanese: そんなわけで答えはまだよく分からないけど、少なくとも今は――
lines.english: So I still didn't really know the answer. But at the very least, right now—

lines.japanese: ん？
lines.english: Hm?

lines.japanese: なにかいま玄関で音がしたような……紀奈子さんか英里子さんが忘れ物でもしたのかな。
lines.english: Had I just heard something at the front door...? Maybe Kinako or Eriko had forgotten something.

lines.japanese: 続けて遠慮がちにドアを叩く音。
lines.english: Then came a hesitant knock.

lines.japanese: 俺は窓べりから身体を起こして玄関へと向かう。
lines.english: I pushed myself from the windowsill and headed for the entrance.

lines.japanese: その小さな音に、微かな想像が頭をよぎった。
lines.english: At that tiny sound, a faint possibility passed through my mind.

lines.japanese: ほのかに浮かぶ淡い期待を持ったまま、ドアノブへ手をかける。
lines.english: Holding on to the pale hope it kindled, I placed my hand upon the doorknob.

lines.japanese: その向こうに待っていたのは――
lines.english: Waiting on the other side was—

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん……」
lines.english: “Big brother...”

lines.japanese: 俺の愛しいひとだった。
lines.english: —the one I loved.
“Kobato...”

lines.japanese: 「どしたんだ、こんなとこで」
lines.english: “What are you doing all the way out here?”
“Well...”

lines.japanese: 「お父さんとお母さん、しばらく仕事で家を離れることになっちゃって」
lines.english: “Mom and Dad have to be away from home on business for a while.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 「その間、お兄ちゃんの家に泊めてもらえないかと思って来てみたの」
lines.english: “So I thought I'd come and ask whether I could stay at your place until they get back.”
“What!?”

lines.japanese: 「だ、ダメかな……」
lines.english: “I-is that... not okay?”

lines.japanese: ダメっていうか……。
lines.english: It wasn't that she couldn't stay...

lines.japanese: 「一人になっちゃうなら、お兄ちゃんと一緒がいいよ」
lines.english: “If I have to be alone, I'd rather be together with you.”

lines.japanese: 「だってお兄ちゃんのいる場所が私の帰るところだもん」
lines.english: “Because wherever you are, big brother, that’s home to me.”

lines.japanese: 彼女は遠慮がちに、でも図々しいことを言ってのけた。
lines.english: She delivered this brazen declaration with shy hesitation.

lines.japanese: 「なに言ってんだ」
lines.english: “What are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: もう分かった。
lines.english: Now I knew.

lines.japanese: どんなに冷静になろうと思っても沸きあがってくる感情。
lines.english: No matter how calmly I tried to think, this feeling came welling up.

lines.japanese: 俺は重そうに抱えている小鳩の荷物に手を伸ばした。
lines.english: I reached for the bags that looked so heavy in Kobato's arms.

lines.japanese: 「うわ、重っ！　なんだ、なにが入ってるんだこれ」
lines.english: “Whoa, this is heavy! What on earth did you put in here?”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん、私の生活用具全部……」
lines.english: “Um, well... everything I need for daily life.”

lines.japanese: 「そんないっぺんに持ってきたのか……ここ、一人部屋だぞ」
lines.english: “You brought it all at once...? This is a one-room apartment, you know.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん、ごめんね」
lines.english: “Y-yes. Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Haaah...”

lines.japanese: 俺は仕方ないなという表情を作ってみせた。
lines.english: I put on a look of weary resignation.

lines.japanese: でもそれは演技だった。
lines.english: But it was only an act.

lines.japanese: 兄としてそんなことで大はしゃぎするわけにはいかない。俺は努めて冷静に微笑んだ。
lines.english: As her brother, I could hardly leap for joy at something like this. I made myself smile calmly.

lines.japanese: 「こんな重いもの、小鳩の力じゃ、片道運ぶのが限界だろ」
lines.english: “You barely had the strength to lug this all the way here. There's no way you're carrying it back.”

lines.japanese: 「一緒に暮らそう」
lines.english: “Let's live together.”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん……」
lines.english: “Big brother...”

lines.japanese: 「うんっ」
lines.english: “Yes!”

lines.japanese: その笑顔を見て確信した。
lines.english: The instant I saw that smile, I knew for certain.

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩のことが好きだ。
lines.english: I loved Kobato.

lines.japanese: 叔父さん叔母さんが帰ってくるまでじゃない、これからもずっと一緒にいよう。
lines.english: Not only until my aunt and uncle came home. From now on, we would always be together.

lines.japanese: 「えへへ、また一緒だね」
lines.english: “Hee-hee. We're together again.”

lines.japanese: 嬉しそうに微笑む無邪気な妹。抱きしめたい気持ちを抑えるのでいっぱいになった。
lines.english: My innocent little sister smiled with delight. It took everything I had not to gather her into my arms.

lines.japanese: 「ま、それじゃあ……」
lines.english: “Well, then...”

lines.japanese: 「上がりなよ」
lines.english: “Come in.”

lines.japanese: 「うんっ……」
lines.english: “Okay...”

lines.japanese: おかえり、俺の大好きなひと。
lines.english: Welcome home, my favorite person.

lines.japanese: 「ただいま、お兄ちゃんっ」
lines.english: “I’m home, big brother!”
